items.headline: Oracle invokes 'force majeure' on Blue Owl's $165B Project Jupiter data center, stock sinks 5-7%
items.note: Oracle sent a force-majeure notice seeking the right to defer payments if the Stargate-adjacent New Mexico campus misses its 2028 open date after regulators repeatedly denied a required pipeline right-of-way; the $18B of debt already backing the project is trading at stressed levels — a realized, forced protective action, not commentary.

items.headline: Blue Owl-sponsored, CoreWeave-leased 'Digital Drive' data center closes $1.1B junk bond at 9.25%, BB-
items.note: The five-year notes priced at 98.5c to yield 9.25%, roughly 2.7pp above comparable debt, with S&P rating the deal BB- and flagging 'exposure to a single, speculative-grade tenant' as the key risk — concrete evidence lenders are pricing in real CoreWeave counterparty risk even as the deal got done.

items.headline: Jane Street-linked Zenith Arc data-center bonds keep souring, secondary yield near 11.3% a month after 9% pricing
items.note: The $2.25B BB-rated Zenith Arc green notes (Oklahoma data center leased to Jane Street) priced near 9% in August and are still trading markedly wider in FINRA data as of Sept 23-24, a persistent markdown signal for non-investment-grade AI data-center paper rather than a one-day blip.

items.headline: Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia bond spreads widen 15-19bps as AI-linked issuance scales up
items.note: Alphabet's spread widened from 56 to 71bps as deal size grew from $1.25B to $3.5B, with Meta and Nvidia seeing similar 15-19bps widening on $4B offerings; AI-linked issuer spreads (~115bps) now trade well wide of the broad IG market (~78bps) — a market-wide repricing of AI infrastructure credit risk, not a single-name story.
